caption: ADP, Inc. v. Wise Payments Ltd.
citation_line: ADP, Inc. v. Wise Payments Ltd., No. 2:21-cv-12457, ECF No. 52 (D.N.J. July 19, 2022)
headnote_district_ruling: Denied a stay of federal trademark and unfair-competition litigation in favor of suspended TTAB proceedings because the Board matters were not advanced, could not supply the full range of relief, and were unlikely to simplify the case.
qualification_rationale: A practical Landis analysis of the relationship between district-court trademark litigation and parallel administrative proceedings.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive stay order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Case-management stay ruling that does not decide the trademark claims or a material defense.
